title: Creating a trading strategy and platform using Claude and GPT
author: LogicVoyager7
selftext: i want to create a trading strategy and platform which i can use to paper trade and backtest ( only for now ). I wont be using any real money to trade and will only test different strategies everyday. For this im thinking to use claude and gpt to do research, implement the complex strategies, data, coding and logic. Since i will be starting it from scratch, so i wanted to ask everyone here who has been currently doing this for long and also some suggestions which i should take care of before starting it. The main point here is i wont be doing real money trading which means its just for my educational purpose.
